rules.title: HTTP client called with a variable URL
rules.message: Outbound HTTP with a non-literal URL. If the URL is user-controlled, enforce allowlists and block link-local/metadata ranges.
rules.fix: Allowlist schemes/hosts; block 169.254.169.254, localhost, private ranges; resolve DNS carefully.

rules.title: fetch() built from concatenation
rules.message: fetch target may be attacker-influenced. Validate destination before egress.
rules.fix: Allowlist destinations; never pass raw user URLs to server-side fetch.
